title: GPT-6 is coming to all tiers of ChatGPT
key_facts: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to ChatGPT with a feature called Intelligent UI.
Intelligent UI can return replies with graphics, tappable buttons, forms and charts, or plain text when visuals do not help.
OpenAI says the feature can help people understand complex topics and build small tools such as a calculator for investment decisions or for splitting a bill.
GPT-6 with Intelligent UI has started rolling out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users worldwide, powered by GPT-6 Sol.
Free and low-cost Go accounts get access sometime today, powered by GPT-6 Luna, which is less capable than Sol.
OpenAI says the model can answer while it is still thinking, and can compose a reply across several messages.
quote_evidence: If you have a Free or a low-cost Go account, you'll get access to the new model sometime today.
OpenAI says the interactive responses could help you understand complex topics more easily with visual aids.
To shorten wait times for complex tasks, OpenAI gave the model the capability to answer while it's still thinking unlike other reasoning models that decide its output first.
why_it_matters_hint: Everyday ChatGPT users get a model whose replies can include interactive tools, with free users reaching it the same day.
event_date: 8 Oct 2026 (article date; the article says the rollout has already started)
notes: Read from the Engadget page (2,148 chars). Launch details are OpenAI's own account as reported; the article did not test the features.
